chunks: It is a (repository of) distinctly written record.
ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Kitabun Marqum' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the divine preservation of revelation, linking the textual integrity of the Quran to the metaphysical reality of Al-Lawh Al-Mahfuz. It serves as a theological guarantee against alteration (Tahrif), affirming that the divine word remains eternally intact in both its written form and its ultimate celestial source.
